purpose: test whether the five frozen current-funding leaders retain the same receiving-leg orientation through a bounded four-day history before spending any request on books, fees, conversion, credentials, or accounts

prefilter_lineage.selection_rule: use the first five exact matches by frozen current absolute funding separation only; preserve each current receiving-leg orientation without historical refit

source_boundary.security_classification: all fifteen requests are documented public market-data GETs with no API key or signature
source_boundary.timestamp_semantics: Polymarket funding rows and Binance funding rows expose epoch-millisecond funding observations; Binance klines are keyed by open time
source_boundary.binance_special_rate_rule: sum Regular and Special dividend funding rows at the same normalized settlement hour because both are cash-flow components

economics.orientation: fixed independently by the current prefilter and never selected or inverted after history access
economics.funding_join: sum the eight Polymarket hourly funding observations ending at each Binance settlement and subtract the complete Binance Regular plus Special settlement cash flow
economics.price_regime_path: use eight consecutive Binance one-hour symbol klines ending immediately before each funding settlement
economics.role_split: oldest 50 percent training, next half of the remainder validation, newest remainder test; expected 6 3 3 at twelve rows
economics.role_gate: each role independently has positive cumulative funding carry after one 20-bip round-trip hurdle and elapsed two-leg capital cost
economics.direction_regimes: up above 0.25 percent, down below negative 0.25 percent, and sideways inclusive between those bounds
economics.volatility_regimes: high at or above the full-window median absolute eight-hour return and low below it
economics.regime_gate: every direction and volatility slice has at least two rows and positive gross fixed-orientation carry
economics.persistence_gate: role gate and regime gate pass, sign consistency is at least 75 percent, and the worst leave-one-settlement-out full-window result remains positive after execution and capital hurdles
unmodeled_before_any_edge_claim: pUSD USDT executable conversion basis fees custody and delay
synchronized executable entry and exit depth and fill probability
exact account fee tiers and owned fill roles
cross-session index and mark divergence and settlement architecture
dividends corporate actions halts liquidation insurance and auto-deleveraging
choppy liquidity and latency stress with prospective paper fills

request_contract.raw_persistence: persist the complete exact request plan before access and every raw response plus receipt metadata before parsing

documented_rate_limit_budget.binance_funding_requests: 5 of the shared 500 requests per 5 minutes
documented_rate_limit_budget.pacing: sequential exact-plan requests with no retry; the complete budget is far below the documented limits

request_contract.retry_policy: none; preserve every response and failure, never adapt symbols windows URLs or downstream book access after seeing outcomes

acceptance_boundary.positive_history_action: retain only as a preliminary persistence candidate and require a separately frozen conversion fee and synchronized depth screen for only the surviving symbols
acceptance_boundary.failed_history_action: request no books and do not repeat this selected population and window absent a material funding fee session or instrument change
